entries.label: PMU Calibration Temperature (tcal)
entries.source: docs/SMC-RESEARCH.md § `ioft` decodes as little-endian 48.16 fixed point — decodes to 51.850, matching IOHIDEventSystemClient's independently-reported `PMU tcal` at 51.850

entries.label: Battery Temperature (Sensor 0)
entries.source: docs/SMC-RESEARCH.md § TB0T/TB1T/TB2T versus the real gas gauge (AppleSmartBattery) — battery-adjacent by key name and tracks the unlabelled `ioft` key TG0B closely, but 3.2°C from AppleSmartBattery's own gas-gauge reading, exceeding this project's 0.15°C corroboration bar; not confirmed as battery temperature

entries.label: Battery Temperature (Sensor 1)
entries.source: docs/SMC-RESEARCH.md § TB0T/TB1T/TB2T versus the real gas gauge (AppleSmartBattery) — battery-adjacent by key name and identical to the unlabelled `ioft` key TG1B to four decimal places, but 0.6°C from AppleSmartBattery's own gas-gauge reading, exceeding this project's 0.15°C corroboration bar; not confirmed as battery temperature

entries.label: Battery Temperature (Sensor 2)
entries.source: docs/SMC-RESEARCH.md § TB0T/TB1T/TB2T versus the real gas gauge (AppleSmartBattery) — battery-adjacent by key name and reads identically to TB0T, but 3.2°C from AppleSmartBattery's own gas-gauge reading, exceeding this project's 0.15°C corroboration bar; not confirmed as battery temperature
